title: Tenma Saki — Fun Like A Dream〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Diner

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
We all have our drinks, right?!
So...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Here's to a job well done! Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Honami & Shiho
rows.Line:
Cheers!
Cheers.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Mmm! Why does the first glass of juice after a show always taste so good?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Probably because we all worked so hard.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank goodness it ended up going so well.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The crowd seemed to like it. I'm pretty sure we put on the best performance we possibly could at this point.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, I know!
Why don't we just move right into a compliment conference right here?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Compliment conference?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Another weird idea...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, we put on a super duper amazing show today! I wanna talk about all the things we did well!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
We can have our usual debrief right after.
So, Shiho, throw me a bone!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, alright...
We did work pretty hard this time around.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yay! You two are also okay with this, right, Ichi, Hona?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I'd also like to take this opportunity to compliment how well you all did.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then, I'll start by showering all of you with love and praise!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Now that I know I'm going to be praised, I'm starting to get a little anxious...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then I'll start with anxious Ichi over here!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What did you do well...? Basically, everything! The way you sang and played your guitar was so powerful... I know you blew the crowd away!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, that also goes for your Blue Moments solo!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The arrangement we came up with was really tricky, so it can't have been easy... But seeing you work hard in practice was a huge source of motivation for me!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And then you totally nailed it during the show!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks...
But I couldn't have done it without all of you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho, you gave me a ton of great advice as we practiced our solos. All of you really helped me out.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What are friends for?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe♪
Alright, Shiho, you're up next!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You were awesome during the show, but you really carried us while we were prepping for it too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It was pretty tough for a bit after we got announced and we saw all those comments online...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But then you reminded us that pros have their duty, and that all we can do is do our best.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, thank you!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: All I did was say what was on my mind.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Next, Hona, you're up!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You did an amazing job of keeping us moving forward during practice and during the show!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Your drums gave me so much power during the show, especially!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I agree. The way you started off the show made it clear that you were determined to succeed. That was really encouraging.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I see... My goal was to lead you all and support you along the way with my drums.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So I'm glad that you all understood my feelings.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Finally, it's my turn to praise myself!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, you're gonna praise yourself?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! I mean, I also worked super hard for this♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, but... Since we're here, Shiho, can you try showering me with praise?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, fine. It is true that you worked really hard.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay, let's see...
Remember how we suddenly decided to rearrange your part during the rehearsal?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We made that change just a few hours before the show, but you nailed it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I was reminded again just how adaptable you are.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
...!
Thank you so much, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Come to think of it, didn't you basically start over from scratch while we were in the green room?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The way you obsessed over it until the last minute made me want to do everything I could to make sure we succeeded.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I also thought you did a wonderful job during the show, Saki. You just seemed to have so much fun getting the audience going.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: They probably couldn't help but smile after seeing you play for them.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wow...
I wasn't expecting to be showered with this much praise...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm so happy that my cheeks might melt away!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Melt?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But really, all of us worked super hard for this!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. It was our first big arena show, and we were opening for Ms. Naruse and her band on top of that. There was a lot of pressure, and I was honestly pretty worried...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But we were able to succeed because we all worked together.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I agree.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Me too!
I feel like we'll be able to do anything as long as we stick together!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, let's keep producing amazing music for everyone as Leo/need forever and ever♪
